title.description: Short imperative summary of the docs change, under 70 characters, for example: Document the Expired status for access keys.

changes.description: One entry per file you edited or created.

description.description: What changed in this file and which product code backs it.

needs_verification.description: Claims you wrote that the code alone cannot settle, such as behaviour in a specific region, a live config value, or the production state of a flag.

manual_followups.description: Changes that are needed but that you may not make, such as a sidebars.js entry for a new page or a docusaurus.config.js meta tag.

no_change_reason.description: When you edited nothing, why. Otherwise an empty string.
